strings.글린다 님, 제가 이야기를 꺼낼 때까지 기다려주셔서 감사합니다. 사실,: Lady Glinda, thank you for waiting until I brought it up. To be honest, I was a little worried. You could have prevented me from coming...
I have no reason to bar someone who bears no ill will. You are not Daphne.
Medea, what you wanted to discuss...
I should give you some privacy. Speak freely.
You are welcome to listen as well, Lady Glinda.
Then I shall. Medea, have some tea too.
Thank you. It has a lovely fragrance.
strings.%s, 괜찮으시다면 제게 잠시 시간을 내주시겠습니까?: %s, if you don't mind, could you spare me some time?
Is there something you need my help with? Something Daphne left...
strings.그는 언제부턴가 오직 저만이 보고 느낄 수 있는 그런 단서를 계속 남겨: For some time, she has continued leaving clues that only I can see and sense.
As though asking me to find something she has hidden.
strings.그래서 시간이 날 때마다 프레이오스에 남겨진 조상들의 발자취를 찾아다녔습: So whenever I had time, I searched Freios for the traces our ancestors left behind.
Yes... They may have been spirits, like the ancestors of the Kali.
strings.생명으로 태어나 고유의 힘을 가지게 됐는데, 사악한 자들이 그걸 알게 되: They were born as living beings and gained unique powers. When evil people learned of those powers, they began exploiting them.
strings.이스트랜드에서는 다른 세계의 영웅이 자신의 세계를 살리기 위해 칼리 일족: In Eastland, a hero from another world turned many living beings, including the Kali clan, into magic stones and tried to destroy our world to save his own.
strings.하아, 프레이오스에는 럭스가 그런 짓을 하고 다니고…. %s 아니었다면: Sigh. And Lux has been doing the same in Freios... I don't even want to imagine what would have happened without you, %s.
I am always grateful to you, %s.
strings.이어서 말씀드리겠습니다. 오랫동안 크리드의 아이들이 희생당한 건 아시겠죠: Let me continue. You know that the children of Creed have been sacrificed for a long time.
It must be because Daphne turned a blind eye.
strings.저는 어떤 식으로든지 다프네와 다시 마주해야 합니다. 지금이 적절한 시기: One way or another, I must face Daphne again. This seems the right time...
Perhaps this is the promise I made to her as a child.
strings.언젠가 때가 되면 자기 뜻을 찾아보라고 했습니다. 어린아이였던 전 그저: She told me that when the time came, I should seek out her intentions. As a child, I thought it was merely a game of hide-and-seek...
strings.지금 저는 저대로, 당신은 당신대로 그 사람을 막아야 하는 상태…. 어쨌: Now, both you and I must stop her in our own ways... In any case, every clue I gathered pointed to one place.
But it is difficult for me to go alone. I need your help, %s.
A place where, according to legend, giants who followed the gods lived before the Twilight era.
strings.알프헤임 북쪽에 위치한 곳으로, 지금은 출입이 금지됐어. 한때는 신의 기: It lies north of Alfheim and is now forbidden to enter. Once, many visited it as a sacred site said to hold divine energy.
strings.그러다가 갑자기 마족과 악마들이 나타나면서 인명 피해가 발생했고, 도크알: Then demons and devils suddenly appeared and people died. The Dokkalfr priests dealt with the situation and sealed the path.
strings.(지나가던 엘리엇이 이야기를 들었는지 발걸음을 멈춘다.): (Passing by, Elliot seems to hear the conversation and stops.)
It seems Daphne has hidden something there.
Of all places to hide it...
It must be no ordinary place.
A rabbit with many things to hide always enters a deep burrow.
strings.흠…. 잠깐만. 혹시 전설 때문이라서 %s에게 도움을 요청한 것인가? 신: Hmm... Wait. Did you ask %s for help because of the legend? Because they follow a god?
strings.용사라 불리던 무리가 그곳에서 거인의 무기를 발견했다는 이야기가 전해지지: There is a tale that a group called heroes discovered a giant's weapon there.
strings.메디아, 이 전설을 따라 린도스에 간다고 해도 찾을 수 있는 가능성은 희: Medea, even if you follow that legend to Lindos, the chance of finding anything is slim. But if Daphne planned this...
Your arrival here must be part of it too.
strings.어렴풋이 짐작은 했어. 도로시와 일종의 거래를 했었던 게 마녀인 건 알았: I had a vague suspicion. I knew a witch had made some kind of deal with Dorothy, but I never thought it was Daphne.
Medea, you have nothing to apologize for.
strings.메디아 님, 정확히 무엇을 찾아야 할지 모르시는 거죠?: Medea, you don't know exactly what we need to find, do you?
I think we will only know once we get there.
As I said before, I feel better when I'm doing something.
It's all right. Don't worry about it.
strings.조금 전에 말했다시피 지금 프레이오스 어디에서도 린도스로 갈 수 있는 길: As I just said, there is currently no path to Lindos anywhere in Freios.
So sealing the path meant making it impossible for anyone to find...
Therefore, we must force a path open.
strings.글린다 님께서는 방법을 알고 계시군요. 뭔가 만들어야 한다면, 제가 가서: You know a way, Lady Glinda. If something must be made, I will gather the ingredients.
strings.그대들이 재료를 모두 구해오면 린도스로 가는 길을 열도록 해보지. 그럼,: Once you bring all the ingredients, I will try to open a path to Lindos. Take your time.
We have brought the ingredients as you instructed, Lady Glinda.
Highland White Herbs... This should be enough. Well done, both of you.
strings.원래는 에메랄디아에서 나오는 재료가 필요했는데, 다행히 대체할 재료가 있: Originally, I needed an ingredient from Emeraldia, but fortunately there is a substitute. It should work.
Now all that remains is to combine them.
strings.그동안 컨디션 회복하면서 기다리는 건 어때?: Why not wait and recover your strength in the meantime?
strings.알겠습니다. %s도 괜찮죠?: Understood. Is that all right with you too, %s?
Good. I'll make sure you rest properly until then.
Hahaha! Don't worry. I won't kill you.
Then we are in your care, Lady Glinda.
%s, the boss will be here shortly. Wait a moment.
Thank you for your hospitality during my stay. I was very comfortable.
Binah, Leticia. I told you there was no need to see us off.
Oh, come on. We'd regret it later if we didn't. Meow.
We came to Dorothy Village together, but now it feels like I'm leaving you behind.
strings.괜찮아여. 잠깐 다녀오시는 거잖아여. 그동안 열심히 수련하고 있을 거예여: It's fine. You're only going away for a little while. I'll be training hard while you're gone.
strings.넹, 돌아가면 더 열심히 일해야져. 수련할 겸 비나와 먼치킨 창고 정리하: Yep. I'll have to work even harder when we return. For training, Binah and I are going to organize the Munchkin Warehouse.
Meow. Leave me out of it. Organizing the warehouse is hard.
I've already told Glinda that Binah and I will tidy it properly.
strings.아하하…. 레티, 최대한 빨리 돌아올게요. 우리 다시 글래스턴으로 가야죠: Ahaha... Letty, I'll return as soon as I can. We have to go back to Glaston together.
Take care too, big sister Medea.
strings.아니에여? 그럼 제가 언닌가여?: Aren't you older? Then am I the big sister?
I am probably the older one. Thank you.
strings.내가 기다리게 했군. 이미 손을 쓰긴 했는데, 그래도 확인할 겸 창고에: I kept you waiting. I'd already made the arrangements, but I went to the warehouse to check.
strings.만다라바가 일단 마을 밖에 있어야 하거든. 내가 만다라바 안에 임페리얼: Mandarava needs to be outside the village. I placed a crystal with properties similar to an Imperial Gate inside him.
strings.알프헤임 마을과 지역을 잇는 게이트가 부서졌을 때 챙겨둔 걸 가져온 재료: I combined something I saved when a gate connecting Alfheim's villages and regions broke with the ingredients you brought.
strings.그러면 만다라바가 어떻게 하면 되죠?: Then what does Mandarava need to do?
strings.만다라바가 뭘 하는 게 아니라. 그대가 해야 해. 두 손으로 들어서 북쪽: Mandarava does nothing. You do it. Pick him up in both hands and throw him north with all your strength.
A path north will open where Mandarava lands.
Yes. Then wait until Mandarava comes back.
strings.엄마, 그거… 만다라바는 알고 있어요?: Mom... Does Mandarava know about this?
strings.안 그래도 보스께서 얼마 전에 최고급 솜을 구해 오셨다. 만다라바도 잔뜩: The boss recently obtained the finest stuffing. Mandarava seems to be eagerly anticipating it.
So this method works because the spirit likes stuffing.
strings.(다들 너무 쉽게 납득하는 것 같은데….): (Everyone seems to accept this awfully easily...)
Then we'll go meet Mandarava on the road. We'll be back, Glinda.
Thank you for everything, Lady Glinda.
I hardly did anything. Return safely. That's all I ask.
I hope you encounter no trouble.
strings.(도로시 마을 사람들이 메디아와 모험가를 배웅하고 돌아선다. 그러던 중,: (The villagers turn back after seeing Medea and the adventurer off. Then Binah stops, apparently remembering something, and catches Leticia's arm.)
strings.엘리엇이 안 보이던데, 혹시 못 봤어요?: I haven't seen Elliot. Have you?
strings.나는 누구도 막을 수없는 완벽한 약초 정령! 따뜻하게 누워서 햇빛을 맞: I'm the perfect herb spirit, unstoppable by anyone! Lying in the warmth and basking in the sun. ♬
strings.(만다라바가 바위 옆에 기대 누워 이상한 노래를 부르고 있다.): (Mandarava reclines against a rock and sings a strange song.)
strings.약초는 다 찾고 놀고 있는 거야?: Have you finished gathering herbs and started playing?
You make it sound as though I'm a spirit who plays instead of working.
strings.(만다라바가 몸을 흔들자 지퍼 사이로 맨드레이크가 얼굴을 내민다.): (Mandarava shakes his body, and a mandrake pokes its face out through the zipper.)
strings.무려 도망간 약초를 붙잡았다! 후후~: I even caught a runaway herb! Hehe!
strings.또 약초 선배라고 충고해서 맨드레이크가 도망간 거 아니야?: Didn't the mandrake run away because you gave it advice as a senior herb again?
I said I was its teacher, not its senior.
I meant no harm. Medea, say something.
strings.맨드레이크가 정령님의 이야기를 들어서 그런지 몰라도 기분이 좋아 보입니다: Perhaps because it heard your words, the mandrake looks quite happy.
Really? Medea understands my profound intentions. Ahem.
strings.너희들 가도엔 약초 찾으러 나온 건 아닌 것 같다. 떠나는 거냐?: You don't seem to have come to the road to gather herbs. Are you leaving?
strings.알프헤임으로 가는 길은 여기 아닌데? 어떻게 가려고?: The road to Alfheim isn't here. How will you go?
Glinda said a path would open on the Oscar Road if we followed her instructions.
A path will open if you do as Glinda says? All right. Travel safely, then.
strings.어? 만다라바. 무슨 방법인지 몰라?: Huh? Mandarava, you don't know the method?
It seems the spirit has not been told.
Glinda recently bought some top-quality stuffing...
strings.오오오오! 역시, 그 솜 내 거였다!!: Oooooh! I knew that stuffing was mine!!
strings.글린다 님께서 새 솜 이야기를 하시면서 정령님께 이야기하면 된다고 하셨습: Lady Glinda said we should mention the new stuffing when we spoke to you.
strings.약초 정령, 멋진 만다라바 님의 도움이 필요한 거구나. 내가 어떻게 하면: So you need the help of the magnificent herb spirit Mandarava! What should I do? Hurry, tell me!
strings.뭐가 미안한 거냐? 어? 왜 날 붙잡고 그래?: Sorry for what? Huh? Why are you grabbing me?
strings.(만다라바가 뭐라 할 틈도 없이 가도 북쪽을 향해 던져진다.): (Before Mandarava can say anything, he is thrown toward the northern end of the road.)
The spirit... is flying like a star in the sky.
I didn't think he'd fly that far...
I'm glad your strength has recovered enough to throw him so far.
strings.걱정해 주셔서 감사해요. 사실 1주일이나 잠들었다고 하는데, 잘 모르겠어: Thank you for worrying. They say I slept for a whole week, but I don't really remember.
strings.겉으로는 괜찮아 보이긴 하지만, 혹시라도 기분이 이상하거나 힘들다고 느껴: You seem fine outwardly, but if you feel strange or unwell in any way, please tell me immediately.
strings.%s. 정령님이 날아간 방향에 뭔가 반짝거리는데…. 혹시 보이나요?: %s, something is sparkling in the direction the spirit flew... Can you see it?
Oh, you're right! It's sparkling over there.
It seems the path has formed.
strings.(그때, 만다라바가 바람에 실려 모험가와 메디아의 앞으로 날아온다.): (Just then, Mandarava rides the wind back to the adventurer and Medea.)
strings.%s, 참 나쁘다! 이렇게 멋진 약초 정령을 던져서 가도 경계에 뒹굴게: %s, you're terrible! You threw this magnificent herb spirit and made me tumble at the road's boundary!
strings.린도스 가는 길을 꼭 이렇게 만들어야 하냐!: Did you have to make the path to Lindos like that?!
Of course, Glinda. An excellent method.
Medea, as long as I get new stuffing, I'm fine. New stuffing...
strings.그러면 내가 친절하게 알려주겠다!: Then allow me to kindly explain!
strings.저쪽으로 쭉 가면 알프헤임 린도스 방향이다. 그런데 거기 위험한데, 둘: Go straight that way to reach Lindos in Alfheim. But it's dangerous there. Will you two be all right?
strings.안 그래도 이상한 곳에 이상한 애들 가득한데, 다프네가 거기 다녀갔다고: It's already a strange place full of strange beings. If Daphne visited, it'll be even more complicated.
We'll have to go and see.
This magnificent spirit will wait here for your return.
strings.다들 갔군. 엘리엇도 어디 가는 거 같던데…. 마수 둥지라도 가나?: They've all gone. Elliot seemed to be going somewhere too... To a beast's nest, perhaps?
Ah, who knows. All I need is sunlight. Ah, so waaarm...
%s, from here we enter the sacred land of Lindos.
strings.(메디아가 지팡이로 커다란 꽃들을 헤치고 앞으로 나아간다. 그러자 바위: (Medea pushes aside enormous flowers with her staff, revealing a path that squeezes between rocky hills.)
I've traveled all over Freios, but I've never seen a place like this.
Perhaps because giants once lived here? Everything is enormous.
strings.확실히 금지구역인가 봐요. 들어가지 말라는 표지판까지 세워져 있는 걸 보: It certainly seems forbidden. There are even signs telling us not to enter...
strings.(메디아가 고개를 들어 하늘을 응시한다.): (Medea raises her head and gazes at the sky.)
strings.린도스 성지에 불길한 느낌이 가득합니다. 역시… 우리를 반기지 않는 누군: Lindos is filled with an ominous feeling. It seems someone here does not welcome us.
And there is more than one. I think a witch is here too.
strings.아뇨, 다프네는 확실히 아닙니다. 그 사람이라면 이런 식으로 기척을 남기: No, definitely not Daphne. She would not leave traces of her presence like this...
...I cannot be certain who it is.
Oh, I felt a little dizzy.
If you're unwell, perhaps we should rest...
Very well. But please don't push yourself too hard.
strings.(힐다가 머리를 감싸 쥔 채 바닥에 주저앉는다.): (Hilda sinks to the ground, clutching her head.)
I thought I could hide here without anyone bothering me...
I can't stay here... I have to go...
strings.(힐다가 뭔가 감지한 듯 고개를 들어 앞을 바라본다 ): (As though sensing something, Hilda raises her head and looks ahead.)
...I have to hide... I can't stay here. If I stay... Ugh...
strings.(힐다가 힘겹게 일어나 주위를 두리번거리고는, 누가 자신을 발견하기 전에: (Hilda struggles to her feet, looks around, and swiftly leaves before anyone can find her.)
Where did she go? She was definitely here...
I think she sensed me coming and hid somewhere.
strings.덕분에 괜찮아졌어요. 설명하긴 어렵지만, 단순히 회복된 게 아닌 것 같네: I'm better thanks to you. It's hard to explain, but it doesn't feel like simple healing.
I merely stabilized your soul. It is a kind of... ability I possess...
strings.어릴 때는 깨닫지 못했죠. 다프네가 원해서 제 능력이 이렇게 발현됐다는: I did not understand as a child. That my ability had manifested this way because Daphne wanted it to...
Perhaps I can help Hilda too.
strings.그럼 힐다와 길게 이야기할 수도 있겠네요. 여기 있는 이유를 알아야겠어요: Then we might be able to have a proper conversation with her. I need to know why she's here.
So you wanted to speak with Hilda.
strings.마녀와 관련된 흔적을 쫓다 보면 항상 힐다가 있었어요. 그리고 힐다가 이: Whenever I follow traces connected to witches, Hilda is there. And something she said to Iris troubles me.
strings.카즈노와 제릴이 하려는 일이 모두에게 예상치 못한 결과를 만들 수도 있다: That what Kazno and Jeril are trying to do could bring unexpected consequences for everyone...
Then we must find Hilda first. Hearing it directly is the surest way.
Why am I the only one who has to suffer like this? Why must I be the one to run...?
No... I don't want to meet my end like this...
strings.(그 순간 힐다의 시야에 자신을 쫓아오던 %s의 모습이 들어온다.): (At that moment, Hilda sees %s pursuing her.)
strings.거기 그대로 있어. 다가오지 마!!: Stay right there. Don't come closer!!
strings.(감정이 참을 수 없이 폭발하면서 힐다의 눈빛이 날카롭게 변한다. 동시에: (Her emotions erupt uncontrollably, sharpening her gaze. At the same time, the surrounding space begins to distort.)
What's wrong with you? This never happened to you before. Why are you... Ugh...
strings.(뒤따라오던 메디아가 지팡이를 바닥에 꽂는다. 순간 공간을 흔들던 진동이: (Medea, following behind, drives her staff into the ground. The tremors stop instantly, and the two facing each other collapse.)
I'm all right for now... But Hilda...
%s, step back for a moment. I'll speak with Hilda.
strings.(모험가가 한 걸음 물러나자 메디아가 조용히 힐다를 향해서 걸어간다.): (As the adventurer takes a step back, Medea quietly approaches Hilda.)
strings.검은 달의 운명을 가진 자 중에 널 모르는 사람은 없어. 함부로 손댈 수: Among those who bear the black moon's fate, no one doesn't know you. Someone we cannot carelessly touch... Ugh...
If you will not come, I will come to you.
Lower your head for a moment.
strings.(메디아가 지팡이를 들어 힐다의 어깨를 두드린다. 그러자 지팡이 끝에서: (Medea lifts her staff and taps Hilda's shoulder. A small light blooms at its tip and envelops her.)
This should keep you well for a while.
strings.(힐다가 혼란스러운 눈빛으로 메디아를 올려다본다.): (Hilda looks up at Medea in confusion.)
Why show me such kindness? You could try to kill me like the other witches...
strings.마음 먹으면 그렇게 할 수도 있지만, 굳이 하지 않았습니다. 할 필요도: I could, if I chose to. But I did not. There is no need.
And I know you would not die willingly.
strings.글린다 님이 계신 마을에 계셔서 아시겠지만, 모든 마녀가 적이 될 필요는: You have stayed in Lady Glinda's village, so you know not every witch needs to be an enemy.
strings.그렇긴 해. 하지만, 저 녀석과 함께 온 것은 이해할 수 없어. 메디아,: True. But I don't understand why you came with that one. Medea, you know, don't you? About our souls...
That's why I can't trust this.
strings.어느 정도는 짐작하고 있었습니다. 하지만, 그렇다고 해서 달라지는 건 없: I had some idea. But that changes nothing.
strings.힐다, 린도스에 온 목적이 따로 있는 것 같은데…. 이대로라면 우리가 린: Hilda, you seem to have a reason for coming to Lindos... As things stand, you will remain in this condition while we are here.
%s had similar symptoms, so I helped them recover too.
It isn't something that gets better through simple healing.
I know. But we cannot leave you suffering.
%s, come here. Hilda is all right.
It's been a while since we've met like this.
...It seems Medea was right. I feel better.
strings.힐다, 할 일이란 게 다프네가 숨긴 뭔가를 찾으려고 한 건가요?: Hilda, were you looking for something Daphne hid?
Not something Daphne hid, but she told me to come here if I wanted to find what I needed.
Our goals differ, but we may be taking the same path...
Hilda, with Medea here, we'll both be all right.
strings.힐다, 당신이 지금 찾겠다고 하는 그 무언가가 린도스에 있는 이상, 이렇: Hilda, as long as what you seek is in Lindos, leaving like this will make things difficult for everyone.
And there is something only %s can do.
That sounds like you're saying coming to Lindos is pointless without that one...
strings.(서로 약속이라도 한 것처럼 모두가 동시에 한 곳을 바라본다.): (As though by agreement, everyone looks in the same direction.)
You said you had something to find.
Let's go, %s. We can check there.
What a welcome they're giving us.
strings.왜 그렇게 보고 있어?: Why are you looking at me like that?
Nothing. I just think there's something big over there.
So there really is something inside Helepol Fortress.
strings.%s. 여길 기준으로 동쪽을 보세요. 석상이 많이 세워져 있죠?: %s, look east from here. Do you see all those statues?
strings.어, 저 석상들…. 혹시 고대신의 모습일까요? 세레스 님과 비슷한 느낌의: Oh, those statues... Could they depict ancient gods? There's a goddess statue that feels similar to Seres.
That's Helepol Fortress. A giant who followed the gods built it before the Twilight era.
strings.무기를 만들었다던 그 거인?: The giant who made the weapon?
Yes. The giant was skillful with his hands and could make anything well.
strings.원래는 신들의 업적을 기리기 위해 만들었던 신전 같은 장소였는데, 시간이: It was originally a temple-like place honoring the gods' achievements. Over time, those with nowhere to go began staying there.
strings.황혼 시절에는 고대신 여럿이 뭔가를 피해 이곳으로 내려왔었던 적이 있다고: They say that during the Twilight era, several ancient gods descended here to escape something.
Many gods stayed, perhaps believing the giant's creation was safe. Afterward, it became a place that saved many lives...
Now it is crawling with monsters, including devils and demons...
strings.그런 곳이었다니…. 몰랐어요. 그런데, 메디아 님은 거인에 대한 이야기를: I never knew it had such a history... But Medea, how do you know about the giant?
When I was a child... She told me.
Another witch with a cruel fate.
You wouldn't have come all the way from Kali if you weren't all right.
strings.다프네와 잠깐 다닌 적이 있었거든. 그때 들었어. 무척 아끼던, 사랑스러: I traveled with Daphne briefly. She told me there had been a beloved child she cherished deeply in that village.
strings.다프네는 평소엔 감정을 잘 드러내지 않는데, 메디아 이야기를 할 때면 무: Daphne rarely shows her feelings, but she was very happy whenever she talked about Medea.
strings.언제 다프네와 함께 다녔어?: When did you travel with Daphne?
strings.네가 아발론 결전을 앞두기 전부터. 우로보로스를 피하려면 다프네 정도의: From before your decisive battle at Avalon. To avoid Ouroboros, I had no choice but to stay with someone as powerful as Daphne.
strings.일단 여기 온 목적부터 해결하자. 걱정하지 마. 이대로 사라지진 않을 테: Let's deal with what brought us here first. Don't worry. I won't disappear on you.
strings.안 들어갈 거야? 안에 있는 게 보통은 아닐 것 같은데…. 아직 준비 안: Aren't we going in? Whatever's inside seems far from ordinary... Are you not ready?
The evil energy reaches all the way here. It is overpowering.
strings.헬레폴 요새 안에 대체 뭐가 있는 거지…. 어, 메디아 님?: What on earth is inside Helepol Fortress...? Oh, Medea?
strings.(메디아가 지팡이로 힐다와 %s의 어깨를 두드린다.): (Medea taps Hilda's and %s's shoulders with her staff.)
As long as we stay together and do not overexert ourselves, we should be all right.
strings.얼마나 걸릴지 모르지만, 잘 부탁해. 여기는 내가 앞장설게. 자, 따라와: I don't know how long this will take, but I'm counting on you. I'll lead here. Follow me.
strings.(두 개의 여신상이 세워진 계단을 따라 올라가자 린도스 성지보다 깊숙한: (Climbing the stairs between two goddess statues reveals a gorge deeper than the sacred land of Lindos.)
strings.…저기 있는 게 다 석상인 거죠? 절벽 보이는 곳마다 세워져 있네요. 저: ...Those are all statues, right? They're set along every cliff. Is that colossal statue looking inward?
To think the giant made all this alone...
It looks sacred, but I sense evil energy everywhere.
There seems to be a poisonous miasma.
I wondered if you were just dull, but Medea's restorative power really is exceptional.
Don't concern yourself with such trivial things.
Something black is flying toward us.
strings.(힐다의 말을 듣자마자 메디아가 지팡이를 고쳐 잡는다. 힐다 또한 작은: (At Hilda's words, Medea adjusts her grip on her staff. Hilda draws a small dagger and readies herself.)
There's something I need to check. When I signal later, attack.
strings.(그 말과 함께 검은 뭔가가 날아와 일행의 앞에서 움직임을 멈춘다.): (With those words, the black object flies in and stops before the group.)
A devil...? No, a devil statue.
strings.(악마 형상이 불길한 기운을 내뿜으며 일행을 빤히 바라본다.): (The devil-shaped figure stares at the group, radiating ominous energy.)
strings.(해골처럼 생긴 석상의 얼굴 틈에서 기괴한 웃음소리가 흘러나온다.): (A grotesque laugh comes from the gaps in the statue's skull-like face.)
It does not seem to be a guardian gargoyle...
strings.「감히 이 몸을 가고일 같은 것과 비교하다니. 어리석은 자들아. 돌아가거: 「How dare you compare me to a mere gargoyle. Fools. Turn back.」
strings.「나, 드미트리가 그대들의 헬레폴 출입을 허락하지 않는다.」: 「I, Dmitri, do not permit your entry into Helepol.」
strings.(드미트리라는 석상이 일행을 향해 검을 들어 겨눈다.): (The statue calling itself Dmitri raises its sword toward the group.)
strings.「돌아가지 않겠다면 여기서 그대들을 모두 벨 것이다.」: 「If you will not leave, I shall cut you all down here.」
strings.뻔한 소릴 잘도 하는군. 어차피 살려 둘 생각도 없잖아. 안 그래, 드미: How predictable. You never intended to let us live anyway, did you, Dmitri?
strings.「감히 필멸자 주제에 위대한 존재의 이름을 함부로 올리느냐.」: 「How dare a mere mortal speak the name of a great being so lightly.」
strings.필멸자 운운하는 걸 보니 네 정체도 너무 뻔한데? 걱정 마. 당신보다 더: Going on about mortals makes your identity rather obvious. Don't worry. I've spoken the name of someone greater than you and survived.
The goddess of the black moon.
strings.(힐다의 대답과 함께 드미트리가 들고 있던 검을 휘두른다.): (At Hilda's answer, Dmitri swings his sword.)
strings.(%s 일행이 드미트리의 공격을 피하긴 했지만, 강한 충격으로 인해 크게: (%s's group avoids Dmitri's attack, but the powerful impact drives them far back.)
strings.헤카테에게 원한이라도 있나 봐?: Do you have a grudge against Hecate?
strings.「그 여자가 만든 족속이라니. 하나도 남김없이 죽여버리겠다.」: 「So you are that woman's creations. I shall kill every last one of you.」
strings.잘은 모르겠지만, 뒤틀린 자가 석상에 갇힌 것 같아. 하는 짓 보면 꼭: I'm not certain, but it seems a Twisted One is trapped in the statue. From its behavior, you'd think it was a devil...
(A blade-like wind rises from Dmitri's sword and attacks the group.)
strings.(힐다와 메디아가 반격하려고 하지만, 이상하게도 두 사람의 공격은 뭔가에: (Hilda and Medea try to counterattack, but strangely, their attacks rebound as though blocked by something.)
strings.(그렇게 몇 번을 시도하지만 둘의 공격은 무력하게도 닿지 않는다.): (They try several times, yet neither can land a blow.)
The goddess of the black moon is no help at all. But it's all right.
strings.「크큭…. 헤카테의 족속들아. 위대한 드미트리에게 검은 달의 기운이 닿: 「Hehehe... Hecate's brood. Do you think the black moon's energy can touch the great Dmitri? You may buy yourselves time, but...」
strings.(드미트리의 밑으로 커다란 소리와 함께 뭔가가 떨어진다.): (Something falls beneath Dmitri with a loud crash.)
strings.(드미트리가 한쪽 어깨를 붙잡고, 바닥에 떨어진 악마 석상의 팔을 내려다: (Clutching one shoulder, Dmitri looks down at the devil statue's arm lying on the ground.)
「Another nuisance. I am curious about your name, but I will not ask. What use is knowing the names of those who will die...?」
strings.「어떤 신도, 어떤 신의 피조물도 손댈 수 없다 했거늘. 하아.」: 「They said no god, nor any god's creation, could touch me. Sigh.」
strings.(드미트리의 짜증 섞인 한숨과 함께 파괴됐던 왼쪽 팔이 다시 재생된다.): (With Dmitri's irritated sigh, the destroyed left arm regenerates.)
strings.「적당히 상대하다 자비를 베풀어 줄까 했는데, 안 되겠군.」: 「I intended to entertain you briefly and show mercy, but that will no longer do.」
strings.「살아서 헬레폴 요새 밖으로 나갈 생각은 하지 마라.」: 「Do not expect to leave Helepol Fortress alive.」
strings.(드미트리가 천천히 날갯짓하며 하늘로 날아오른다.): (Dmitri slowly beats his wings and rises into the sky.)
strings.「어리석은 필멸자가 위대한 존재의 뜻을 어찌 알겠느냐?」: 「How could a foolish mortal understand a great being's will?」
「I shall wait there. No place could be better suited to tormenting your souls.」
strings.(그 말과 함께 주위가 어두워진다. 어둠은 금방 사라졌지만, 눈앞에 있던: (The surroundings darken at those words. The darkness soon fades, but the devil statue is gone.)
strings.메디아, 지팡이에 있는 잎 하나만 써도 될까?: Medea, may I use one leaf from your staff?
Of course. But what will you use it for...?
I have a feeling we'll need it...
strings.(어디에 쓰려는 거지…?): (What is she planning to use it for...?)
strings.아, 힐다. 내 공격이 드미트리에게 먹힐 수 있다는 건 어떻게 알았어?: Oh, Hilda. How did you know my attack would work on Dmitri?
strings.너만이 할 수 있는 일이 있다고 했잖아. 아마 그게 아닐까 생각했을 뿐이: We were told there was something only you could do. I simply thought that might be it.
...So I literally have to use my strength. Sigh...
strings.드미트리가 있는 곳에 뭐가 있는 건지 알 수 없지만…, 일단 가봐야겠습니: We don't know what awaits where Dmitri is... But we must go and see.
strings.위대한 존재라고 하더니, 혼자 힘으로는 힘들었나 봐. 지금까지 숨어있던: He calls himself a great being, but apparently he can't manage alone. The devils and demons that were hiding are coming.
Nothing personal. Your only mistake was attacking me.
strings.(힐다의 발밑에 쓰러진 악마가 외마디 비명을 지르며 소멸한다.): (The devil fallen at Hilda's feet vanishes with a final scream.)
...All the monsters pursuing us have withdrawn.
Now we just need to find Dmitri... %s, don't relax yet.
strings.힐다와 메디아 님의 공격이 왜 드미트리에게 통하지 않는 거야?: Why don't your attacks and Medea's work on Dmitri?
I have a theory. He seems to have made some kind of promise or contract.
strings.하지만 헤카테가 드미트리에게 어떤 식으로든 해를 입히지 않겠다고 약속한: But I doubt Hecate promised never to harm Dmitri in any way.
strings.엘리시아의 주인인 헤카테가 엘리시아에서 다른 신을 공격하는 경우는 거의: As Elysia's mistress, Hecate almost never attacks other gods there. If she did, it would have been to protect the place she treasures.
We were affected simply because of our connection to Hecate. Otherwise...
strings.드미트리가 갇힌 석상 때문일까? 어떤 신과 어떤 존재의 힘도 영향을 미칠: Could it be the statue trapping Dmitri? Something no god's or other being's power can affect...
Considering the giant, that seems entirely possible.
Then my attacks shouldn't work either.
strings.그동안 신이 된 인간은 이리스를 제외하고 아무도 없어. 그걸 변수라고 해: No human besides Iris has ever become a god. I don't know whether to call that an unforeseen factor, but...
strings.(일행이 앞을 돌아본 순간, 주변 공간 전체가 어두운 그림자로 가득 채워: (The moment the group turns forward, dark shadows fill the entire surrounding space.)
strings.(그리고 그 틈에서 사악한 불꽃을 내뿜는 악마 석상이 모습을 드러낸다.): (Through them appears the devil statue, spewing wicked flames.)
strings.「용케도 이곳까지 왔구나. 헤카테의 아이들이여.」: 「You have done well to come this far, children of Hecate.」
Cough, cough. So this is the poison you mentioned. It's overwhelming...
The miasma is denser than that of a high-ranking devil born in the abyss.
strings.「약속한 대로 이곳에서 너희들을 죽여 버리겠다. 너희들이 죽는 걸 지켜볼: 「As promised, I shall kill you here. I look forward to Hecate's face as she watches you die.」
strings.헤카테 님과 무슨 일이 있었는지는 모르겠지만, 우리와는 상관없잖아. 필요: I don't know what happened between you and Hecate, but it has nothing to do with us. Let us find what we need and leave.
strings.「너희들은 그렇겠지만, 난 아니다. 너희들은 모르겠지. 헤카테로 인해 악: 「Perhaps not to you, but it does to me. You cannot know what it feels like to be trapped in a devil statue because of Hecate, and become a devil yourself!」
I don't think Hecate has that sort of hobby... Anyway, it's a purely personal grudge.
strings.그러면 우리를 죽이는 것만으로 충분한 거야?: So will killing us be enough?
strings.「너희들을 죽이고, 밖으로 나가 황혼 시절처럼 프레이오스 대륙을 불태울…: 「I shall kill you, go outside, and burn Freios as I did during the Twilight era...」
strings.(그 말을 들은 힐다가 메디아와 %s의 손을 붙잡고 황급히 뒤로 물러난다: (At those words, Hilda grabs Medea's and %s's hands and hurriedly retreats.)
strings.저건 더는 뒤틀린 자가 아니야. 스스로 심연 속으로 뛰어든 악마일 뿐이지: That is no longer a Twisted One. It is only a devil that plunged into the abyss of its own will.
「Hehehe. Quite clever. I thought you would be weak and foolish like Hecate... Graaah!」
strings.(드미트리의 주위에 사악한 불꽃이 터지더니 그대로 드미트리를 감싼다.): (Wicked flames erupt around Dmitri and envelop him.)
The reason our attacks did not work...
The statue itself was made that way. So no being could destroy it, except a particular person...
strings.「용사라고 불리던 인간이 거인의 유산을 찾아 온 것 같은데….」: 「Humans calling themselves heroes once came seeking the giant's legacy...」
strings.「반은 죽어 내게 영혼을 바쳤고, 반은 도망갔다. 그러고 보니 네가 그때: 「Half died and offered me their souls. Half fled. Come to think of it, you resemble the human called a hero back then. Hehehe.」
strings.「너희의 영혼을 모두 내게 바쳐라!! 헤카테를 죽일 수 있게 어서 이 자: 「Offer all your souls to me!! Die here, all of you, so I may kill Hecate!!」
strings.(그 순간, 드미트리가 일행을 향해 돌진한다. 한편, 멀리 높은 곳에서: (At that moment, Dmitri charges the group. Far above, a boy looks down and gives a faint laugh.)
This seems a little different from what I know...
Well, it doesn't matter. Whoever wins is on our side. Do your best.
strings.(%s의 연이은 공격에 드미트리의 꼬리와 날개가 부서져 바닥에 떨어지지만: (%s's repeated attacks break Dmitri's tail and wings, sending them to the ground, but they regenerate.)
Hah, hah. There's no end to it.
Medea, handle the remaining monsters. It'll only take a moment.
strings.(힐다가 메디아의 지팡이에 있던 나뭇잎을 하나 떼어 내고는 드미트리를 향: (Hilda plucks a leaf from Medea's staff and walks toward Dmitri.)
strings.「크큭. 너와 싸울수록 네 안에서 영혼이 느껴지는군. 신의 축복을 받은: 「Hehehe. The more I fight you, the more clearly I sense the soul within. If I could only devour a soul blessed by a god...」
A former god becoming a devil and coveting living souls. How pathetic.
strings.「크큭. 아무것도 할 수 없는 존재가 그런 말을 내뱉다니 우습구나.」: 「Hehehe. How amusing to hear such words from someone who can do nothing.」
strings.(힐다가 씨익 웃으며 단검으로 검지 끝을 살짝 벤다. 그 틈으로 흘러나온: (Hilda grins and lightly cuts the tip of her index finger with her dagger. She lets the blood drip onto the leaf from Medea.)
strings.(그 말과 함께 힐다가 나뭇잎에 모인 피를 드미트리를 향해 흩뿌린다.): (With those words, Hilda scatters the blood gathered on the leaf over Dmitri.)
strings.「크큭. 스스로 제물이 되겠다는 의지라면 이런 모욕도 받아들이지.」: 「Hehehe. If that is your declaration that you offer yourself as a sacrifice, I will accept even this insult.」
strings.모욕으로 받아들이다니 유감이야. 신들도 무서워했던 능력을 이렇게 쓰게 될: A shame you take it as an insult. I never thought I'd use this ability, which even gods feared, like this.
%s, go and destroy as much as you like.
strings.(순간 %s의 빈틈을 노려 드미트리가 검을 휘두른다. 겨우 피하지만, 강: (Seizing an opening in %s's guard, Dmitri swings his sword. You barely avoid it, but the force drives you back.)
strings.「크큭. 약한 존재가 감히 나를 뛰어넘을 수 있을 거라 믿느냐. 너희들은: 「Hehehe. Do you weaklings truly believe you can surpass me? You shall offer your souls to me here.」
strings.뛰어넘을 수 있을지 모르겠지만…. 나는 없던 걸 만들어 내고, 사라진 게: I don't know whether we can surpass you... But I can create what wasn't there, and make what disappeared return.
strings.(힐다의 말이 끝나기 무섭게 모험가가 드미트리의 뒤로 들어가 날개를 파괴: (No sooner has Hilda spoken than the adventurer moves behind Dmitri and destroys his wings.)
strings.「…쓸데없는 말로 시간을 버는군. 재생하면 그만이다.」: 「...Buying time with empty words. I need only regenerate.」
strings.(드미트리가 당황한 듯 비어 있는 날개 부분을 매만지더니 고통스러운 듯: (Dmitri feels around where his wings should be, then screams in pain loudly enough to shake all of Helepol Fortress.)
strings.재생되어야 할 부분이 가로막혀 안으로 돌아가는 것뿐이야. 석상에 갇혀있는: The parts that should regenerate are blocked and turning inward. They'll wrap around you, trapped inside the statue.
strings.그러다 보면 넌 영원히 바깥으로 나오지 못하는 채로 석상과 하나가 되겠지: Eventually, you'll become one with the statue, unable to come out ever again...
strings.「크아악…, 일개 인간이 이, 이렇게 할 리가 없어. 헤카테에게 영향을: 「Graaagh... A mere human c-could never do this. Even under Hecate's influence...」
I am a witch. By wounding myself, I can make you unable to rise again. Unable to regenerate.
Perhaps that's why Ouroboros wants me...
%s, what are you doing? Finish him...
strings.(그때, 드미트리가 힐다의 손목을 붙잡는다.): (At that moment, Dmitri grabs Hilda's wrist.)
strings.「크아아아! 내가 이대로 무너질 줄 아느냐!!」: 「Graaagh! Do you think I will fall like this?!」
strings.「너희를 붙잡고 심연의 늪으로 뛰어들 것이다!! 너희를……! 크아아아아악: 「I shall seize you and plunge into the abyssal swamp!! I shall... Gaaaaagh!!」
strings.(드미트리가 온몸이 갈라지는 고통에 몸부림치면서도 한쪽에 어두운 그림자를: (Though writhing as his whole body cracks apart, Dmitri creates a dark shadow to one side.)
strings.(하지만 그것도 잠시, 그림자를 만들어내던 드미트리의 팔이 그대로 바닥에: (But only for a moment. The arm creating the shadow falls to the ground and crumbles to dust.)
strings.(악마 석상이 다시 발악하며 모험가를 붙잡으려 하지만, 다가오는 공격에: (The devil statue struggles again to seize the adventurer, but collapses under the incoming attack.)
Dmitri, you must have known your end from the moment you chose to become a devil.
One who is not merely twisted, but foolish...
...Hilda, it seems he'll destroy himself if we leave him...
What we seek will appear only when he vanishes.
Huh, who are you talking to? Oh...
strings.(머리와 다리에 붕대를 감고, 한 손에는 잔을 들고 있는 소년이 일행을: (A boy with bandages around his head and leg approaches, holding a cup in one hand.)
Hello, everyone. I have no intention of fighting, so don't be wary.
strings.뒤틀린 자가 왜 여기 있는 거지?: Why is a Twisted One here?
strings.「메노…. 네놈이 왜 여기에…. 너는 분명 그때 소멸한 걸로 아는데….」: 「Meno... Why are you here...? I thought you vanished back then...」
%s, I'll help you reach the next area.
strings.응. 그뿐이야. 대신 드미트리의 처분은 내게 맡겨. 한때 신이었단 자를: Yes. That's all. In return, leave Dmitri's disposal to me. I'm better suited than humans to deal with someone who was once a god.
strings.그렇기는 하지만, 너를 어떻게 믿지?: Perhaps, but how can we trust you?
strings.내가 어떻게 하면 믿을까? 아, 그래. 마녀 다프네의 이야기를 해준다면: What would make you trust me? Oh, right. Would you trust me if I told you about the witch Daphne?
strings.다프네는 참 신통해. 어떻게 드미트리의 기억까지 조작해서 거기 들어갔는지: Daphne is quite remarkable. I don't know how she even altered Dmitri's memories to get inside. Even I couldn't do that. Hehe. Now...
%s, thank you for playing along with my little prank last time. This is my repayment.
What you're looking for is there. Daphne hid it away very carefully.
strings.힐다, 메디아 님. 어떻게 할까요?: Hilda, Medea. What should we do?
strings.…조금 전 %s의 공격으로 린도스 성지 어딘가에 뭔가 나타난 것 같습니다: ...It seems your attack just now caused something to appear somewhere in the sacred land of Lindos, %s.
strings.우리가 만났던 장소에서 서쪽이지?: West of where we met, right?
strings.(메노이티가 자신을 바라보는 %s에게 미소를 보낸다.): (Menoiti smiles at %s, who is watching him.)
I suppose we have to trust him and go...
Then let us head down quickly.
strings.「메노, 날 어쩔 셈이지….」: 「Meno, what will you do to me...?」
Dispose of you, exactly as I said. Unlike you, I've been given a 'chance.' So I'll live anew in the present time.
strings.(메노이티가 성배를 흔들자 그 안에 물이 가득 채워진다.): (Menoiti shakes his chalice, and it fills with water.)
strings.드미트리, 악마가 된 걸 축하해. 같은 부류가 아니어서 죄책감 같은 게: Dmitri, congratulations on becoming a devil. Since we're no longer the same kind, I don't feel guilty anymore. Isn't that fortunate?
strings.(성배 안에 있던 물이 조금씩 끓어오른다. 잠시 후, 메노이티가 부서진: (The water in the chalice begins to boil. Soon, Menoiti pours it over the broken Dmitri's head.)
strings.네가 먼저 도망가자고만 하지 않았어도…. 헤카테를 돕자고 했던 약속을 지: If only you hadn't suggested fleeing first... If only you'd kept our promise to help Hecate...
This world would be many times more beautiful now...
strings.(헬레폴 요새에서 나온 힐다가 잠시 발걸음을 멈추고 뒤돌아본다.): (After leaving Helepol Fortress, Hilda stops and looks back.)
strings.혹시 피를 흘려서 몸 상태가 나빠졌나요?: Has losing blood made you unwell?
strings.(힐다가 조금 전 단검으로 찔렀던 검지 끝을 보여준다.): (Hilda shows the fingertip she cut with her dagger.)
Every time I wasn't all right before, it was because of you.
Don't worry about such trivial things.
strings.잠깐, 두 분…. 뒤를 보시겠습니까?: Wait, both of you... Would you look behind us?
strings.(메디아의 말에 모험가와 힐다가 헬레폴 요새의 입구를 바라본다.): (At Medea's words, the adventurer and Hilda look toward Helepol Fortress's entrance.)
Look where the colossal statue you admired is facing.
Huh? Oh... You're right. It's facing west.
strings.키 작고 뒤틀린 자가 약속을 지킨 건가. 헬레폴 요새 안에 있던 드미트리: Did that short Twisted One keep his promise? Dmitri's presence inside Helepol Fortress is gone.
The monsters following Dmitri's orders are no longer pursuing us either.
strings.메디아, 혹시 이거 온전한 형상…, 그러니까 구체 같은 걸로 만들 수 있: Medea, could you make this into a solid form... Say, a sphere?
strings.(힐다가 조용히 메디아에게 나뭇잎에 담긴 뭔가를 전달한다.): (Hilda quietly hands Medea something gathered on a leaf.)
I thought it might be useful, so I kept a little.
strings.힐다, 이거 어디에 쓰려고?: Hilda, what will you use it for?
strings.힐다, 시간이 좀 필요합니다. 악마가 된 존재에게서 나온 물건은 일단 정: Hilda, this will take time. Something from a being who became a devil must first be purified...
strings.그러면 완성된 후에 어떻게 받으시겠습니까? 글린다 님에게 맡기면 어떨까: How would you like to receive it when it's done? I thought I might leave it with Lady Glinda.
I'll collect it from Dorothy Village. Oh...
I'd like you not to be in Dorothy Village when I do.
You two get along better than I expected.
...We don't get along badly. The circumstances are bad. Oh, Medea... Look.
strings.(일행이 바라보던 서쪽에서 뭔가가 바람을 가르며 달려온다.): (Something races through the wind from the west, where the group is looking.)
strings.(일행과 부딪칠 뻔하지만, 다행히도 모두를 지나쳐 어딘가로 향한다.): (It nearly collides with the group, but fortunately passes everyone and continues onward.)
Wh-What was that strange thing...? It looked like a horse...
strings.여기서 무기와 석상을 만들었다는 그 거인?: The giant who made the weapons and statues here?
I heard it once. I don't quite remember from whom...
Sigh. I know Briareus is gone, yet I...
You must have been close, calling his name like that.
strings.(힐다가 나타나자 말의 다리를 가진 여성 수인이 뒤로 물러난다. 그리고: (At Hilda's appearance, a female beastfolk with a horse's legs steps back. Sensing others, she raises her sword warily.)
A hero? Oh, Daphne? No, someone who looks similar.
strings.(여성 수인이 들고 있던 검을 내려놓고 %s 일행을 빤히 바라본다.): (The female beastfolk lowers her sword and stares at %s's group.)
If you know Daphne, this should be easier to explain.
strings.다프네가 여기서 뭔가를 찾아보라고 한 거지?: Daphne told you to look for something here, didn't she?
strings.헬레폴의 악마 석상은 어떻게 했어? 그거 일반적인 방법으론 상대할 수 없: What did you do about the devil statue in Helepol? You can't deal with it by ordinary means.
...We defeated it, but a Twisted One came and should have finished it off.
strings.그걸 쓰러뜨렸어? 뒤틀린 자가 왔다고?: You defeated it? A Twisted One came?
Hilda, we need to explain this clearly.
strings.그러면 여기까지 온 이유와 여기서 있었던 일을 내가 이해할 수 있게 이야: Then tell me why you came and what happened here in a way I can understand.
Before that, I should tell you who I am.
I am Tyrenia, descendant of the Chiron clan.
strings.(자신을 티레니아라고 소개한 여성이 귀를 쫑긋거린다.): (The woman introducing herself as Tyrenia pricks up her ears.)
(Medea gives Tyrenia a clear account of why the group came to Lindos.)
strings.너희가 왜 여기 왔는지, 린도스가 어떻게 됐는지 대충 알겠어. 다프네에게: I understand roughly why you're here and what happened to Lindos. I wondered when I would repay my debt to Daphne...
It seems today is the day.
From your reaction, Tyrenia, I think there is something more...
If it's Daphne, she must have arranged things so Tyrenia would do something.
I'll say you're half right. Then I suppose I should tell my story...
strings.다프네에게 들었어. 그때를 '황혼'이라고 불렀다고. 나는 아마도 그 시간: I heard from Daphne that they called that time the 'Twilight.' I was probably someone who lived then.
I'm not certain, but it was around then.
strings.신이었던 자가 타락해서 악마나 다름없는 존재가 됐지. 살아있는 생명의 영: Someone who had been a god fell into corruption and became no different from a devil. He descended on my village to take the souls of the living.
I don't remember clearly what happened, but a spirit saved me... And brought me here to Lindos.
strings.말투가 이상한 정령이었어. 여기가 안전할 거라고 하면서 금방 사라졌는데,: One with an odd way of speaking. It said this place would be safe and quickly disappeared. Then...
strings.우리 마을을 엉망으로 만들었던 악마가 쫓아왔어. 그때는 신과 같은 존재였: The devil who had ruined our village followed me. Back then, he was a godlike being, but had become a fallen devil...
strings.맞아. 드미트리가 내 영혼을 가져가려고 하는 순간, 엄청나게 큰 사람이: Yes. Just as Dmitri tried to take my soul, an enormous person appeared, seized him, and lured him away.
strings.그러더니 숨어있던 내게 나타나서 손을 내밀어 줬지. 악마를 붙잡아서 다시: Then he appeared before me where I was hiding and offered his hand. He said he'd caught the devil and made sure it could never get out again...
strings.그게 브리아로스와의 첫 만남이었지. 그 후로 친구가 됐고, 난 그에게서: That was my first meeting with Briareus. We became friends, and he helped me a great deal.
strings.나중에 알았지만, 마계에서 나 같은 사람의 영혼을 모으고 있단 걸 알았어: I learned later that the Demon Realm was collecting the souls of people like me.
strings.어쨌든 브리아로스는 자기가 거인이라 마족이나 악마 같은 게 쉽게 오지 못: Anyway, Briareus reassured me. He said demons and devils couldn't easily come because he was a giant.
And he gave me a safe place to stay. That place is...
strings.(티레니아가 이야기를 이어가던 중, 갑자기 린도스 성지가 흔들린다.): (As Tyrenia continues, the sacred land of Lindos suddenly shakes.)
strings.…별거 아니야. 그곳의 주인인 내가 오랫동안 밖으로 나와 있어서 그런 것: ...It's nothing. Only because I, the place's guardian, have been outside too long...
Follow me. I'll explain the rest on the way.
strings.(말을 마치기가 무섭게 티레니아가 일행이 있던 공간을 벗어나 힘껏 달린다: (No sooner has she spoken than Tyrenia races away from the group.)
She could at least slow down so we can follow...
I think what we're looking for is in the place Tyrenia said she guards.
How much of this has Daphne arranged...?
Medea, let's return to where we were just now.
strings.거인이 만들었던 안전한 공간이라면…. 흠, 일단 가 보는 수 밖에 없겠어: If it's a safe place made by the giant... Hmm. We'll have to see...
strings.기다렸잖아. 왜 이렇게 느린 거야?: I've been waiting. Why are you so slow?
...Our bodies are different. You cannot simply say that...
Sorry. I ran too fast without thinking.
Now I'll take you to the place I guard. The 'Trial of Iron'...
strings.브리아로스가 무기를 만든 공간이야. 그의 손에서 완벽한 무기가 되지 못한: The place where Briareus made weapons. The metal remnants that never became perfect weapons in his hands remain there.
Think of it as both the cradle and grave of weapons.
strings.브리아로스 덕분에 나는 린도스에서 안전하게 지낼 수 있었어. 그의 무기를: Thanks to Briareus, I could live safely in Lindos. Ill-intentioned people came almost daily seeking his weapons, but he protected me.
strings.그러다 마계의 도시 판데모니움으로 연결되는 통로가 대륙 여기저기 나타났어: Then passages to Pandemonium, a city in the Demon Realm, appeared all over the continent.
I think they were called Pseudaria...
strings.철의 시련의 주인으로서 너희가 안으로 들어오는 걸 허락할게. 철의 시련은: As guardian of the Trial of Iron, I permit you to enter. It's this way.
strings.구름 사이에 커다란 검이 보이지?: See the enormous sword among the clouds?
Oh, there was nothing there a moment ago...
strings.이 길은 악마 석상을 무력화해야 나타나. 일종의 장치 같은 건데 설명하긴: This path appears only after the devil statue is neutralized. It's a kind of mechanism, but complicated to explain. Briareus designed it that way from the start.
Now that Dmitri is gone, the path will never be permanently closed.
So when the path was closed, you couldn't come outside.
I had no particular reason to go outside.
Walk without thinking too much, and you'll see something new. Follow me. I'll match your pace this time.
strings.(티레니아를 따라 구름 사이로 걸어가자, 시야에 보이는 풍경이 바뀐다.): (Following Tyrenia through the clouds, you see the scenery change.)
Weapons are embedded in the cliffs and rocks...
Things that cannot, or must not, be used.
strings.저걸 다 브리아로스라는 거인께서 만들었단 말이군. 크기도 종류도 모두 다: So the giant Briareus made all of them. Different sizes, different types, and different energies...
It somehow reminds me of the Sanctuary.
A place where battle angels and Valkyries live.
strings.모두 사라진 줄 알았어. 다들 잘 지냈구나. 미카엘라, 라파엘라, 그리고: I thought they'd all vanished. So they've been well. Michaela, Raphaella, and Gabriella...
Michaela is in the Sanctuary, and Raphaella is in the Aegir Ruins...
strings.그렇구나. 한 번 만나러 가보고 싶은데…. 언젠가 무기를 만들러 여럿이: I see. I'd like to visit them sometime... Several of them once came here to have weapons made.
strings.브리아로스가 엄청나게 공을 들여서 무기를 만들어줬어. 성능도 확인할 겸: Briareus put tremendous effort into making their weapons. They sparred with me to test them too.
strings.오랜만에 밖으로 나왔다고 한 것 같은데…. 그동안은 나오시지 못하셨습니까: You said it had been a long time since you went outside... Were you unable to leave before?
Briareus disappeared some time after the era called the Twilight.
strings.아까 마계의 문이 대륙 곳곳에 나타났다고 했었지?: I mentioned the Demon Realm's gates appearing across the continent, right?
Then someone came. Everyone called him a hero.
strings.용사는 그 문을 닫기 위해 브리아로스의 무기가 필요하다고 했어. 브리아로: The hero said he needed Briareus's weapon to close those gates. Briareus agreed to give him one if he passed several tests.
strings.그중엔 나와 대련하는 조건도 있었어. 꽤 괜찮은 무기를 받아들고 만족했던: One condition was to spar with me. I remember how pleased he was when he received a fine weapon.
strings.그런데, 용사가 돌아가고 얼마 지나지 않아 엄청나게 많은 마족들이 린도스: But not long after the hero left, an enormous number of demons attacked Lindos.
The moment Briareus saw them, he put everything outside into this place. Even me...
strings.그때는 다시 만날 수 있을 거라고 생각했는데,: I thought we would see each other again then.
strings.오랫동안 문이 열리지 않았어…. 당연히 나가지도 못했고, 브리아로스도 못: But the door did not open for a very long time... Of course, I couldn't leave or see Briareus.
Eventually, the door opened. But it wasn't Briareus before me. It was a demon who had forced it open to seize the weapons.
strings.그 마족이 모르는 게 있었어. 이곳의 규칙을 따라야 원하는 걸 얻을 수: There was something that demon didn't know. You can only get what you want by following this place's rules, and it failed to do so.
strings.맞아. 그 규칙은 바로 일대일로 브리아로스를 쓰러뜨리는 것이지. 프리링: Yes. The rule is to defeat Briareus in single combat. But when there's no Priring, a Puriring will do. The guardian now is me, not the giant.
Then you mean we must follow that rule too.
That must literally be the trial...
strings.쉽지 않겠다고 생각했습니다. 그런데, 우리 중에서 누가 티레니아 님을 상: I knew it would not be easy. But which of us will face you, Tyrenia?
%s. I'd like it to be you.
strings.신의 축복을 받은 너와 겨뤄 보고 싶어. 드미트리와 싸웠다면서? 궁금하거: I want to test myself against someone blessed by a god. You fought Dmitri, didn't you? I'm curious. And Daphne recommended you too...
What did Daphne do to help you, Tyrenia...?
I'll tell you once you reach the place where I'll be waiting. I promise.
strings.제대로 싸우고 싶은 것처럼 보이는데…. 그렇게 해야 원하는 걸 얻을 수: You look as though you want a proper fight... If that's the only way to get what we need, we have no choice. Sigh.
Then we will see you shortly, Tyrenia.
strings.(그 말을 끝으로 티레니아가 빠른 속도로 철의 시련 안쪽으로 달려간다.): (With those words, Tyrenia races deeper into the Trial of Iron.)
Somehow, it reminds me of that place in Elysia.
That place was born from Hecate's whims. This one is a little different, though.
We haven't even started, and they're already coming.
strings.%s, 힐다. 방심은 금물이에요. 조심하세요!: %s, Hilda. Do not let your guard down. Be careful!
strings.(힐다가 바닥에 쓰러진 몬스터들을 보고는 작게 한숨을 내쉰다.): (Hilda sighs quietly at the monsters fallen on the ground.)
Are all these here to guard the giant's weapons...?
strings.그건 그렇다 쳐도 티레니아와 비슷하게 생긴 수인들은 뭐지…?: Even so, what are those beastfolk who look like Tyrenia...?
strings.티레니아 님과 함께하는 정령입니다. 거인과 함께 무기를 만들던 정령들이: They are spirits who accompany Tyrenia. The spirits who made weapons with the giant must have gradually taken after her.
Simply a person, like you, me, or Medea.
strings.특별한 힘이 깃든 장소에서 수련하고 전투 천사와 대련할 정도면 스스로도: To train in a place filled with special power and spar with battle angels, she must have worked incredibly hard.
strings.거인 브리아로스에게 무기와 석상을 만드는 것 외에도 다른 능력이 있을 같: I have the impression that Briareus had abilities beyond making weapons and statues.
Considering how he controlled this space to keep Tyrenia safe, well...
strings.(메디아가 가리킨 절벽 끝에서 티레니아가 하늘을 바라보며 서 있다.): (At the cliff's edge where Medea points, Tyrenia stands gazing at the sky.)
strings.(커다란 소리와 함께 방패가 바닥에 꽂힌 채로 회전한다. 이어서 티레니아: (With a tremendous noise, a shield embeds itself in the ground and spins. Tyrenia descends from the cliff and charges.)
strings.(반격하려던 모험가가 강한 충격으로 멀리 밀려난다.): (As the adventurer tries to counterattack, a powerful impact drives you far back.)
strings.힐다와 메디아는 물러서. 지금부터 누구든 이 싸움에 관여했다가는 아무것도: Hilda and Medea, step aside. From now on, if anyone interferes, you will gain nothing.
...Attacking without warning is a little unfair...
strings.(티레니아가 떨어진 방패를 들고는 모험가를 향해 검을 겨눈다.): (Tyrenia picks up her fallen shield and points her sword at the adventurer.)
I wouldn't have come this far without being prepared.
Then show me what you can do.
strings.과연 내게서 그걸 가져갈 수 있는지 해 보라고!: Show me whether you can take it from me!
strings.(티레니아가 %s의 강한 공격에 뒤로 밀려난다. 반격하려고 했지만, 다리: (Tyrenia is driven back by %s's powerful attack. She tries to counter, but her legs give way and she sinks to the ground.)
Sigh... It can't be helped. I lost. I acknowledge my defeat...
strings.(티레니아가 주저앉은 채로 한숨을 내쉬고는, 품 안에서 뭔가를 꺼내 %s: (Still seated, Tyrenia sighs, takes something from her clothes, and gives it to %s.)
Daphne entrusted this to me. As promised, I'll give it to you.
strings.(초승달 모양의 검은 돌이 %s의 손안에서 보랏빛으로 반짝거린다.): (A black crescent-shaped stone glows purple in %s's hand.)
From your surprise, it seems this is no ordinary object.
It symbolizes the ancient god Hecate.
strings.헤카테 님이 어떤 신인지는 잘 모르지만, 어쨌든 다프네에게 이걸 받았을: I don't know what kind of god Hecate is, but I should tell you how Daphne gave me this.
strings.프세우다리아라는 이름의 마계 통로는 한동안 나타나지 않다가 얼마 전에 다: The Demon Realm passages called Pseudaria stopped appearing for a time, then returned recently.
At that moment, this space shook, and demons and devils poured out.
strings.혼자서 그들을 모두 막을 수 없어서 이대로 죽는구나 싶었을 때, 그때 다: I couldn't stop them all alone. Just when I thought I would die, Daphne appeared.
strings.손짓만으로 적들이 서로 싸우게 만들고, 지팡이를 두드려서 적을 움직이지: With a gesture, she made the enemies fight each other. With a tap of her staff, she immobilized them. It was incredible.
strings.모든 상황이 끝난 후에 내 손을 붙잡아 일으키면서 브리아로스처럼 버티라고: When it was over, she took my hand, helped me up, and told me to endure like Briareus. She said she would do the same...
strings.그리고 내게 이걸 맡기면서 언젠가 여길 찾아올 메디아와 힐다에게 전해 달: Then she entrusted this to me and told me to give it to Medea and Hilda when they came here someday.
She said it was the same object, but would mean different things to each of us...
strings.(메디아와 힐다가 검은 달 조각을 받아 손에 쥔 순간, 그대로 주저앉는다: (The moment Medea and Hilda take the black moon fragments in their hands, they sink to the ground.)
strings.(놀란 모험가가 서둘러 메디아와 힐다를 붙잡는다.): (Startled, the adventurer hurriedly catches Medea and Hilda.)
It is nothing. I felt dizzy for a moment...
It's all right... Nothing happened... I'm really fine.
strings.(메디아와 힐다가 손에 있는 검은 달 조각을 보고는 말을 잇지 못한다.): (Medea and Hilda stare at the black moon fragments in their hands, unable to speak.)
You both seem to have realized something...
I'm sorry, Tyrenia. We can't tell you.
strings.짐작 가는 게 있긴 하지만, 묻지는 않을게. 알게 되면 분명 슬퍼질 테니: I have a suspicion, but I won't ask. Knowing would surely make me sad.
There are things we need to do to prepare for danger. We'll return and get ready.
strings.(%s의 말을 들은 티레니아가 미소를 지으며 가까이 다가온다. 그리고 살: (At %s's words, Tyrenia smiles, approaches, and gently touches her forehead to yours.)
I wish you success. This is our clan's greeting.
strings.감사합니다, 티레니아 님. 그런데, 이제 어떻게 하실 겁니까?: Thank you, Tyrenia. But what will you do now?
strings.나? 앞으로도 쭉 브리아로스의 유산을 지켜야지. 그게 내가 여기 있는 이: Me? I'll keep guarding Briareus's legacy. That's why I'm here.
I fall short of Briareus, but if you need my help, come find me.
strings.뭐, 그런 셈이지. 아, 다음에 여기 올 때는 대련 말고는 싸우지 않을: Something like that. Oh, next time you come, we won't fight except for sparring.
So there will still be sparring.
Sigh. It feels such a shame to let you go like this...
strings.티레니아 님, 설마 대련하자고요?: Tyrenia, don't tell me you want to spar again?
strings.너희, 뭐라도 먹고 갈래?: Would you like something to eat before you go?
I would. I was just wishing for some tea...
strings.그러면 뜨거운 물을 부탁드려도 되겠습니까? 좋은 향을 품은 찻잎이 있습니: Could I ask for hot water? I have some wonderfully fragrant tea leaves.
strings.%s, 힐다, 좀 쉬었다 가시는 건 어떤가요?: %s, Hilda, why not rest a little before leaving?
Why ask my opinion? You've already decided... Fine. I'll eat. What's on the menu? Is it good?
Tyrenia, you didn't need to come this far.
Thank you for seeing us off.
It's been so long since I spent time like this. I really enjoyed it.
It was good to meet you, Tyrenia.
I hope your next visit is for something good.
strings.(티레니아가 케이론 일족 특유의 인사법으로 안녕을 고한다. 그리고 다시: (Tyrenia bids farewell with the Chiron clan's distinctive greeting, then races back toward the Trial of Iron.)
As Tyrenia said, next time we should visit for a happy reason.
strings.검은 달의 조각 말이야. 여기에 있는 이유를 알아야 하지 않겠어?: About the black moon fragments. Shouldn't we know why they were here?
strings.메디아, 그거 말할 거지?: Medea, you're going to tell us, right?
strings.대신 여기 말고 내가 숨었던 곳으로 가자. 중요한 이야기를 할 거면 이왕: But let's go to the place where I hid. If we're discussing something important, we may as well be careful.
Returning here, I understand why you insisted on this place.
Adjust the flow of magic a little, and no sound can escape.
And you interrupted it. Sigh. Let's leave that subject.
strings.(메디아가 검은 달의 조각을 꺼내 하늘에 들어 보인다.): (Medea takes out the black moon fragment and holds it toward the sky.)
strings.제가 이걸 받았던 순간, 머릿속에 떠오르는 장면이 있었습니다. 어딘가에서: When I received this, a scene appeared in my mind. Somewhere, Daphne was holding it and speaking to me.
strings.내가 잠깐 도와줄까?: Shall I help for a moment?
Give me your hand for a moment. Your hand. Yes, that's it.
strings.(모험가가 힐다의 손을 잡은 순간, 낯설지 않은 사람의 모습 하나가 흐릿: (The moment the adventurer takes Hilda's hand, a familiar figure faintly appears.)
strings.「이걸 손에 넣었다면 여신의 사람과 함께 있겠구나. 이런 과정을 겪지 않: 「If you have obtained this, you must be with the goddess's follower. I should not have made you go through this. I am sorry.」
strings.「아이야, 나는 네가 행복하기를 원했단다. 그래서 네가 이 밤에 발을 내: 「My child, I wanted you to be happy. That is why I hoped you would never step into this night.」
strings.「너에게 손대지 않겠다고 마계 군주에게서 약속을 받아냈지만, 그건 역시: 「I obtained a promise from a ruler of the Demon Realm not to touch you, but that was a mistake. I should never have trusted a demon...」
strings.「욕심 많은 럭스가 원했던 이걸 네가 맡거라. 칼리 마을로 돌아가서 조용: 「Keep this, which the greedy Lux desired. Return to Kali Village and store it somewhere quiet.」
strings.「너라면 잘 보관할 것이다. 그리고 걱정할 필요 없단다.」: 「You will keep it safe. And there is no need to worry.」
strings.「꽤 힘들었지만, 네게 호의를 베풀지 않을 존재는 모두 칼리 마을을 기억: 「It was difficult, but I made it so that anyone who would not show you goodwill can neither remember nor enter Kali Village.」
strings.「…나머지는 내게 맡겨 다오……. 이게 내 마지막….」: 「...Leave the rest to me... This is my final...」
That is exactly what I saw.
If it's what Lux wanted, could it be...
The power of people like Hilda and me resides in these black moon fragments...
...Daphne... What on earth was she thinking...?
strings.(힐다가 다시 모험가의 손을 붙잡자 조금 전과는 다른 낯선 풍경이 흐릿하: (As Hilda takes the adventurer's hand again, an unfamiliar scene different from before faintly appears.)
strings.(거인이 린도스를 향해 다가오는 누군가를 향해 뛰어간다. 적으로 보이는: (A giant runs toward someone approaching Lindos. The apparent enemy offers a hand, but the giant refuses.)
strings.(적이 거인의 공격을 가볍게 튕겨내고는 조소를 띈다. 그리고 거인의 무기: (The enemy easily deflects the giant's attack, sneers, and destroys all his weapons.)
strings.(남은 건 단 하나. 거인이 커다란 검에 포를 탑재한 무기를 꺼내 들고는: (Only one remains. The giant draws a weapon combining an enormous sword with a cannon and charges the enemy.)
strings.(거인의 공격에 적이 밀려나고, 착용했던 뭔가가 바닥에 떨어진다.): (The giant's attack drives the enemy back, and something the enemy was wearing falls to the ground.)
strings.(거인이 쓰러진 적을 붙잡고 심장을 찌르려고 하지만, 갑자기 피를 토하고: (The giant seizes the fallen enemy and tries to pierce the heart, but suddenly coughs blood and collapses. His body turns into a broken statue and crumbles.)
strings.(거인의 무기는 적이었던 자의 손에 들려 사라진다. 그 모습을 마지막으로: (The giant's weapon disappears in the enemy's hand. With that final image, the vision of Lindos's past evaporates.)
strings.하아…, 다프네…. 정말 미쳤어…?: Sigh... Daphne... Have you truly gone mad...?
strings.(그 모습을 보고 있던 힐다가 그대로 주저앉는다.): (Watching the scene, Hilda sinks to the ground.)
strings.왜 이걸 내게 보여주는 거야…? 브리아로스는 여길 지키기 위해서 스스로: Why show me this...? Briareus made his own choice to protect this place... This isn't what I wanted...
To choose to become a slayer of gods, a Deicide...
strings.내게 필요한 건 우로보로스에게서 벗어나 숨을 곳이었다고…. 다프네도 그걸: What I needed was somewhere to hide from Ouroboros... Daphne knows that...
strings.아가슈라에게 붙잡히면, 우로보로스가 날 찾아온다고. 우로보로스가 찾아오면: If an Agasura catches me, Ouroboros will come for me. And when Ouroboros comes, everything disappears...
Everyone will die... Only then does it end...
What she's doing seems insane, but perhaps it's her own way of caring.
I agree it is insane, though I do not know whether to call it consideration.
Thank you for the offer, but...
Stay there for a while. You'll be all right with Medea.
Hilda, if you want what you entrusted to me, come with me.
strings.(힐다가 이마를 매만지며 한숨을 내쉰다. 그리곤 메디아가 내민 손을 잡고: (Hilda rubs her forehead and sighs, then takes Medea's offered hand and stands.)
I give in. I'll go. Happy?
strings.잘 됐어요, 메디아 님. 그럼 바로 칼리로 가시나요?: I'm glad, Medea. Are you going straight to Kali?
strings.린도스에서 칼리로 바로 갈 수 있는 길이 없어서 오스카 가도로 가야 합니: There is no direct route from Lindos to Kali, so we must go to the Oscar Road. Let us travel together that far.
strings.이 길…, 다시 봐도 신기하군요. 정령님을 던졌을 뿐인데, 오스카 가도와: This path is remarkable, however often I see it. We merely threw a spirit, and it connected to the Oscar Road.
strings.만다라바를 던졌더니 길이 생겼다고?: You threw Mandarava, and a path appeared?
We did as Glinda instructed, and it really happened.
Glinda must have put something inside Mandarava. Anyway, Medea...
strings.칼리에 가기 전에 도로시 마을에 잠깐 들러도 될까? 글린다하고 비나에게: Before we go to Kali, could we stop briefly at Dorothy Village? I'd like to say goodbye to Glinda and Binah...
Of course. With me here, you need not worry about %s either.
Let's go, Hilda. You too, Medea.
strings.(모험가가 바위 위에 누워있는 만다라바를 바라보다가 흔들어 본다.): (The adventurer looks at Mandarava lying on the rock, then shakes him.)
strings.으아아아, 어지럽다! 정신을 잃을 정도로 햇빛이 너무 좋았을 뿐이다!: Aaaah, I'm dizzy! The sunlight was just so wonderful I lost myself in it!
strings.메디아? 힐다? 너희, 따로 떠났는데 왜 여기 있냐?: Medea? Hilda? You left separately. Why are you here together?
No, no! That's not important. Hilda, listen.
The ones Hilda least wants to meet seem to be in Glaston.
strings.만다라바, 너 그걸 어떻게 알았어?: Mandarava, how do you know that?
strings.나는 정령. 알 수도 있고 모를 수도 있다. 잔말 말고 어서 떠나는 거다: I'm a spirit. I may know, or I may not. Stop talking and leave quickly.
strings.글래스턴에는 왜 왔지…?: Why have they come to Glaston...?
%s, it seems you must return to the village alone.
Hilda, as the spirit says, there is no time to linger.
Hearing Mandarava say that makes me more anxious...
This way is safe. It's a tunnel to Lifthrasir.
strings.(만다라바가 옆에 있던 바위를 건드리자 뿅~ 하는 소리와 함께 커다란 굴: (Mandarava touches a nearby rock, and a large tunnel appears with a pop.)
strings.이런 건 또 언제부터 있던거야?: Since when has this been here?
strings.%s, 힐다와 제 걱정은 마시고 마을로 돌아가세요. 때가 되면 연락 드리: %s, do not worry about Hilda or me. Return to the village. I will contact you when the time comes.
strings.(힐다와 메디아가 만다라바와 모험가에게 인사를 한 뒤 빠른 걸음으로 가도: (Hilda and Medea say goodbye to Mandarava and the adventurer, then leave the road at a brisk pace.)
%s, let's go to the village now.
strings.(만다라바가 둥실둥실 떠올라 %s의 어깨에 앉는다.): (Mandarava floats up and sits on %s's shoulder.)
I've had my fill of sunlight. Even the leaves on my head are fresh.
strings.이제 들어갈 시간이야?: Is it time to go inside?
strings.들어가서 쉬어야 한다. 아, 비밀이 하나 있는데, 너한테만 살짝 알려주겠: I need to go in and rest. Oh, there's a secret. I'll tell only you.
strings.다프네가 내 앞에 나타났었다. 엄청나게 좋은 고급 솜을 들고 와서 내게: Daphne appeared before me. She brought incredibly fine stuffing and asked a favor.
strings.힐다와 메디아가 제대로 떠날 수 있게 해달라고 부탁했다. 그게 글린다를: She asked me to make sure Hilda and Medea could leave safely. She said it was for Glinda too. You know what that means, don't you?
strings.혹시 몰라 여신님께 여쭤봤는데, 괜찮다고 하셨다. 힐다를 위한 게 널 위: I asked the goddess just in case, and she said it was all right. I heard that helping Hilda helps you too.
strings.(만다라바가 고개를 들어 하늘을 바라본다.): (Mandarava raises his head and looks at the sky.)
The movements of the spirits in Glaston have changed.
strings.아니다. 좋은 거다. 사람들의 머리를 흔들었던 불길했던 기운이 단숨에 사: No. It's good. The ominous energy disturbing people's minds vanished all at once. Oh, how curious.
strings.나는 그쪽 동네 정령 아니라서 모르겠다. 일단 마을로 가자, 가자!: I'm not a spirit from that area, so I don't know. Let's go to the village!
strings.내 옆에서 같이 건조되고 있던 맨드레이크 못 봤냐? 행복한 표정을 지으면: Have you seen the mandrake that was drying beside me? The one drying out with such a happy expression.
Goodbye, Mandarava. I'll go ahead. I'll tell Glinda I didn't see you.
My friend. Please. Help me. Please help.
strings.하아…. 알았어. 그러면 나중에 너도 나 도와주기다?: Sigh... All right. Then you help me next time too, understood?
strings.(모험가는 어쩔 수 없이 만다라바와 함께 약초를 찾기로 하고서 가도 여기: (With no choice, the adventurer agrees to search for the herb with Mandarava and runs around the road.)
strings.(멀리있는 분수대 위에서 누군가가 바라보고 있다는 것도 모른 채.): (Unaware that someone is watching from atop a distant fountain.)
